troubleshootIntro.message: Files not showing up? Quick things to try:

fallbackIntro.message: Some files (spreadsheets, blobs, etc.) can't be downloaded directly via the API. Copy the prompt below and paste it into your Claude chat to get a downloadable ZIP.

fallbackPromptText.message: I need you to create a downloadable ZIP file containing ALL the files in this project's knowledge base. Do NOT regenerate or modify the content — simply copy each file exactly as-is into a ZIP archive and provide a download link. Include every file regardless of format (documents, spreadsheets, images, PDFs, etc.).

fallbackPasteHint.message: Paste this into your Claude chat on the project page.

backupHowBody.message: Lahat ng nangyayari ay sa computer mo lang — walang na-upload sa kahit anong cloud. Naka-save ang mga backup bilang ZIP file sa Downloads › Claude Backups. Tumatakbo ang automatic backup habang bukas ang computer mo, bukas ang Chrome, at naka-sign in ka sa claude.ai; kung may namiss, tatakbo ito sa susunod na pagkakataong totoo ulit ang mga ito.
